executive_summary.text: Cost year 2024: laundry cost per resident day ($9.5) was 176% of the Connecticut median ($5.41). Ask what drove the higher laundry cost (contracts, supplies, staffing or a one-time expense).
Cost year 2024: direct care cost was $162.44 per resident day (45.6% of expenses); Connecticut median $169.07.
Cost year 2024: nursing home operating margin was 0.5% (Connecticut median 0.5%).
Cost year 2024: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $135,374, 2.0% of the $6,806,181 direct care cost.

Cost year 2024: dietary cost $1,322,808, $31.57 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.6). Wages $704,349 (53.2%), allocated fringe $268,251 (20.3%), non-wage costs $350,208 (26.5%). Raw food was $324,654 ($7.75 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.59) and purchased dietary services $-32,333.
Cost year 2024: housekeeping cost $413,606, $9.87 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.07). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $413,606 (100.0%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2025 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

limitations: The latest filed cost year (2025) failed the site's checks, so this report uses cost year 2024.
Dollar figures are as filed, before DSS audit, and are not adjusted for inflation. Compare per-resident-day figures with the Connecticut median for the same year.
Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075314/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
